key_idea: Show the existence of a coloring without monochromatic cliques by proving that a uniformly random coloring has the desired property with positive probability.
reason: This is the seminal example of the probabilistic method, achieving a profound result in a few lines. By recasting a deterministic existence problem into a simple probabilistic calculation, it elegantly bypasses the need for complex constructions.
recognized: Erdős (1947) lower bound on diagonal Ramsey numbers / The Probabilistic Method
